description_excerpt: Job Description Role Purpose The Senior Demand Planner is responsible for developing and maintaining a robust, accurate, and commercially aligned demand plan across ASEAN markets. The role translates market intelligence, customer requirements, commercial strategies, historical demand, and statistical analysis into a reliable demand signal that supports optimal inventory, service levels, and business performance.
